observations.text: Official manual: PRC-76 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-76 stage 1, TEK-79 changes into NIX-34.
In PRC-76 stage 2, NIX-34 changes into MUR-68.
In PRC-76 stage 4, SIV-41 changes into terminal marker JOT-56.
